verdict_text:
YES

The script removes every tensor of blocks 2, 6, 10, 14, renumbers the survivors in original order to 0..11 while preserving the rest of each name and the tensor values, passes the two non-block tensors through unchanged, and writes a single `model.safetensors`. The assertions run before saving, so a failure leaves no output: the layer-index set must equal exactly {0..11} (which rules out any block 12..15 and guarantees exactly 12 blocks), and the tensor count must be 86.
